claims: The Artemis II mission is a crewed lunar flyby mission.
The Artemis II mission is scheduled to launch on Wednesday, April 1, 2026.
The launch window for the Artemis II mission opens at 6:24 p.m. EDT.
The Artemis II mission will launch from Kennedy Space Center's Launch Complex 39B.
The Artemis II mission is a four-astronaut mission.
The Artemis II mission will last approximately 10 days.
The Artemis II mission will test critical life-support systems on the SLS rocket and Orion capsule.
The launch window for the Artemis II mission is 2 hours long.
The location of the Artemis II launch is Kennedy Space Center, Florida.
Backup launch dates for the Artemis II mission are available April 2-6 and April 30.
Broadcast of the Artemis II mission is available on NASA's YouTube channel and NASA+.
The Artemis II mission will be the first crewed flight to the Moon since 1972.
